settings.train_loss_note: `train` is the optimiser's own minibatch average with dropout active; `train_eval` re-scores the training split in eval mode with the same objective as validation and test
settings.test_split_usage: reported only; never used for stopping, scheduling, checkpoint or threshold selection

reproduction.note: per-epoch validation AUROC of the re-run versus the stored run; the re-run is the figure source
